# 1. Setup

## - Setting work directories

Defining work directory within rmarkdown chunk

```{r setup, include=TRUE}
local_wd_folder = dirname(dirname(dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path)))
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = local_wd_folder)
```

```{r}
setwd(local_wd_folder)
```

## - Setting seed

This step ensures reproducibility in randomized processes

```{r}
set.seed(seed = 123, kind = "Mersenne-Twister", normal.kind = "Inversion")
```

## - Options

```{r}
options(Seurat.object.assay.version = 'v3')
```

## - Loading libraries

```{r}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(Seurat)
library(scuttle)
library(scater)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(R.utils)
library(gridExtra)
library(scDblFinder)
```

## - Defining input data and output directories

```{r}
data_folder = paste0(local_wd_folder, '/Data/10x')
results_folder = paste0(local_wd_folder, '/Results/10x')

dir.create(path = paste(results_folder, '/VDJ', sep = ''), showWarnings = F)
```

## - Loading palettes

```{r}
# Load additional colour palette packages
library(unikn, quietly = TRUE)
library(RColorBrewer, quietly = TRUE)
library(yarrr, quietly = TRUE)
library(scales, quietly = TRUE)
library(ggsci, quietly = TRUE)

# Define a set of custom color palettes from the unikn package
mix_1 <- usecol(pal = c(Karpfenblau, "white", Peach), n = 15)
mix_2 <- usecol(pal = c(rev(pal_seeblau), "white", pal_pinky))
mix_3 <- usecol(pal = c(rev(pal_bordeaux), "white", pal_petrol), n = 15)

# Display the custom palettes
seecol(list(mix_1, mix_2, mix_3), col_brd = "white", lwd_brd = 4, title = "Comparing palettes mixed from unikn colors", pal_names = c("mix_1", "mix_2", "mix_3"))

# Define a second set of custom palettes from the RColorBrewer and yarrr packages
brew_mix <- usecol(c(rev(brewer.pal(n = 4, name = "Reds")), "white", brewer.pal(n = 4, name = "Blues")), n = 13)
brew_ext <- usecol(brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "Spectral"), n = 12)
yarrr_mix <- usecol(c(piratepal("nemo"), piratepal("bugs")))
yarrr_mod <- usecol(c(piratepal("ipod")), n = 9)

gradient_exp <- rev(c('#FFAB01', '#FC8805', '#FC5D05', '#D92211', "#D9043D", "#A6036D", "#7C038C", "#5503A6", "#A69AEE", '#D9D4F7', "#FFFFFF", "#F4F7FF", '#E9EBEF'))

# Display the second set of custom palettes
seecol(pal = list(brew_mix, brew_ext, yarrr_mix, yarrr_mod), col_brd = "white", lwd_brd = 2, title = "Using usecol() and seecol() to mix and modify palettes", pal_names = c("brew_mix", "brew_ext", "yarrr_mix", "yarrr_mod"))

# Define additional custom palettes from the scales package
natjournals_palette <- pal_npg("nrc")(10)
```

# 2. INPUT: Importing pre-filtered samples

```{r}
Merged.SeuratObj <- readRDS(paste(data_folder, 'SC_Objects', 'Added_ADT.rds', sep = '/'))
```

# 3. Loading VDJ data

```{r}
VDJ_data <- read.table(paste(data_folder, 'VDJ', 'BCR_DATA.csv', sep = '/'), sep = ',', row.names = 'X',
                       header = T)

for (s in colnames(VDJ_data)[str_detect(colnames(VDJ_data), 'sequence')]) {

  VDJ_data[[s]] <- gsub("\\.", "", VDJ_data[[s]])

}

rownames(VDJ_data) <- VDJ_data$cell_id
```

```{r}
Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data$cell_id <- rownames(Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data)

merged_data <- Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data %>%
  left_join(VDJ_data, by = "cell_id")

rownames(merged_data) <- merged_data$cell_id
```

```{r}
n_cells_without_vdj <- sum(is.na(merged_data$clone_id))
n_cells_with_vdj <- ncol(Merged.SeuratObj) - n_cells_without_vdj

percentage_cells_without_vdj <- round((n_cells_without_vdj/ncol(Merged.SeuratObj))*100,1)
percentage_cells_with_vdj <- round((n_cells_with_vdj/ncol(Merged.SeuratObj))*100,1)

###

n_cells_without_vdj_per_sample <- list()
n_cells_with_vdj_per_sample <- list()

percentage_cells_without_vdj_per_sample <- list()
percentage_cells_with_vdj_per_sample <- list()

for (s in unique(merged_data$Identity)) {
  
  n_cells_without_vdj_per_sample[[s]] <- sum(is.na(merged_data %>% filter(Identity == s) %>% pull(clone_id)))
  n_cells_with_vdj_per_sample[[s]] <- nrow(Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data %>% filter(Identity == s)) - n_cells_without_vdj_per_sample[[s]]

  percentage_cells_without_vdj_per_sample[[s]] <- round((n_cells_without_vdj_per_sample[[s]]/nrow(Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data %>% filter(Identity == s)))*100,1)
  percentage_cells_with_vdj_per_sample[[s]] <- round((n_cells_with_vdj_per_sample[[s]]/nrow(Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data %>% filter(Identity == s)))*100,1)
  
}


```

```{r}
Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data <- merged_data

merged_data_to_export <- cbind(
    Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data, 
    as.data.frame(as.matrix(t(Merged.SeuratObj@assays$ADT@data[, rownames(Merged.SeuratObj@meta.data)])))
  )

# Replace <NA> with NA (without angle brackets)
merged_data_to_export[is.na(merged_data_to_export)] <- ""

write.table(
  merged_data_to_export, 
  file = paste(results_folder, 'VDJ', 'Comprehensive_metadata.tsv', sep = '/'), 
  sep = "\t",  # Use tab as the delimiter
  row.names = FALSE, 
  quote = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
saveRDS(Merged.SeuratObj, paste(data_folder, 'SC_Objects', 'Added_VDJ.rds', sep = '/'))
```
